summary: Route Mode slice 4. The learning map (prerequisite graph) is stored per project in the knowledge-base record keyed by the real project id, reusing its revision check, undo log and backups: new route-save / route-manual / route-start / route-mode operations, pathgraph.validate as the gate for structured graphs, App.route_get deriving per-concept progress from explicit feedback (undo, freeze and seeds respected), GET/POST /api/route, and cleanup on project delete. The category forest and corpus of the shared 'default' record are unchanged. An independent review found 6 defects and several low items, all fixed.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-mode, on top of bdd8b0a. Touches the knowledge-base storage, undo log and server routes (critical paths). The owner's .claude files are excluded locally.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call, no network, no new outbound data; the map holds concept names and search terms the user sees and edits.
budget_impact.before: The learning path was saved at creation and never read.
budget_impact.after: A validated, undoable per-project map whose progress is derived from explicit feedback; no UI uses it yet.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt; window not clicked through

reviews.reviewer: One separate read-only code-review agent (same model family, not a human); findings fixed afterwards, fixes not re-read by a reviewer.

open_risks: Narrower than planned: only the map is project-scoped; the classification view and its corpus still use the global library and the 'default' record.
The independent review was by an agent of the same model family; its findings were fixed and the fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.
route_get recomputes paper assignment on every call (not cached); fine at thousands of papers, slower beyond.
The route block carries no schema version field; a future change will need a compatible reader.
Nothing in the UI uses the map yet (slices 5 and 6); E-ROUTE, R-ROUTE and ROUTE-01 are not registered yet (slice 8).
